subject: Endurance test added as a GitHub workflow (#731)
reason: The change is purely CI/tooling: it adds a new GitHub workflow (.github/workflows/endurance_tests.yml), a benchmark driver script (scripts/benchmark/run_endurance_test.sh), and installs jq in the devcontainer Dockerfile. No module source, command handling, indexing, replication, or persistence code is touched, so the loaded valkey-search module behaves identically at the change and its parent; there is no runtime behaviour for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
